verdict.rationale: gstack uses SKILL.md files as its skill format (across skills like review, qa, ship, cso, etc.) and explicitly lists support for multiple AI coding agents beyond Claude (Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain) via typed host configs, suggesting some folder-format portability. However, none of the evidence explicitly states adherence to an open 'Agent Skills' specification or that the SKILL.md folder format is a recognized cross-vendor standard rather than gstack's own convention with per-host adapters. Missing for 10: explicit citation of an open Agent Skills spec, confirmation that the raw skill folder works unmodified in other vendors' tools without gstack's host-adapter layer, independent validation of spec compliance.
